narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The fifth stroke goes beside the other four, one more in the row.
<bookmark mark='row'/>But a long row of single strokes looks like a fence, and we must count each one again.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We could easily count one stroke twice, or miss one, and lose our place.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Make one stroke for each count, and tie every five into a bundle.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Joseph draws three bundles and two loose strokes. How many children chose that sweet?
